## What's new
**Updates now say what changed.** When a new version turns up, the notice shows its changelog right there in the dialog — what's new, what's fixed — before you decide whether to restart.
- The changelog arrives inside the same release feed EmoPic already fetches, so reading it sends nothing extra to GitHub. - The "you're up to date" notice now has a **Version History** button that opens every release in your browser.
Update automatically via **Settings → About → Check for Updates**.
